parts.summary: USTelecom opposes the proposed definition of consultant, arguing that it would unnecessarily layer duplicative requirements on top of existing oversight and could inhibit service providers' ability to serve E-Rate customers, undermining the goals of the program.

The FCC's proposed changes to the E-Rate program aim to modernize and streamline the competitive bidding process, while preserving existing market-based approaches to pricing. The NPRM cites existing FCC documents and regulations to support its proposals, such as the adoption of a USAC-managed competitive bidding portal and the preservation of the lowest corresponding price (LCP) and cost-effectiveness rules.
